fields.description: Stable internal code for this question, e.g. "gst_registered". Referenced by follow-up questions' "Only when answer is" and never shown to the user.
fields.label: Question Key

fields.description: The plain-language question shown to the user, e.g. "Does the customer have a GSTIN?"
fields.label: Question

fields.description: Which step of the Deal Wizard this question appears in.
fields.label: Applies To

fields.description: Which record this question's answer is written onto.
fields.label: Target Doctype

fields.description: Fieldname on the target doctype, e.g. "gst_category". Checked against the doctype's actual fields on save. Use "sales_team" (on Customer) for a Sales Person question — it is special-cased to append a Sales Team row instead of setting a plain field.
fields.label: Target Fieldname

fields.description: Fixed: a curated list of answers you define below (Options). Dynamic: the answers are live records from another doctype (e.g. enabled Sales Persons) — still a friendly picked list, never a raw search box.
fields.label: Question Type

fields.description: Doctype the live options are fetched from, e.g. "Sales Person".
fields.label: Source Doctype

fields.description: Fieldname shown to the user as the answer's label, e.g. "sales_person_name". Defaults to the record's name.
fields.label: Source Label Field

fields.description: Optional Frappe filters as JSON, e.g. {"enabled": 1, "is_group": 0}. Wrap a previous answer in {{ }} to filter by it, e.g. {"territory": "{{ answers.territory }}"}.
fields.label: Filters (JSON)

fields.description: Only ask this question after another one has been answered a particular way, e.g. a "Regular or Composition?" follow-up that only appears when "Does the customer have a GSTIN?" was answered "Yes".
fields.label: Only After Question

fields.description: The Answer Key (not label) of the answer above that must have been chosen.
fields.label: Only When Answer Is

fields.description: Used, and flagged on the Review step, when the user's path through the questions leaves this field unset.
fields.label: Fallback Value

fields.description: Lower runs first. Later questions targeting the same field overwrite earlier ones (only when their chosen answer has an Assigned Value) — this is how two follow-up questions about the same field combine.
fields.label: Order

fields.description: Roles allowed to override this question's assigned value on the Review step before submitting. One role per line. Leave empty to never allow overriding.
fields.label: Override Allowed For Roles
